featured_reviews.review_text:

Manage by herself and the lunch they provided next was missing the dal and raita and they expected her to wait again so they could redeliver the missing food. This is the unprofessional service ever.

featured_reviews.name: Meher A.T. G
featured_reviews.review_text:
NOT RECOMMENDED! Today was the first day of my trial order. I had signed up for the full meal which was supposed to contain 2 vegetables, dal, rice, accompaniment and roti.
1) One vegetable was NOT SENT.
2) The other item sent as a vegetable was CHOLE! Is CHOLE A VEGETABLE?
3) After informing them that the second vegetable had not been sent, I was told it would be delivered in 10 minutes(I live close to the tiffin service place). It was delivered after almost an hour. Seems like the vegetable prepared for the day must have been over because what I received was PANEER BHURJI. AGAIN NOT A VEGETABLE!
4) The item sent as a dal was a WATERY KADHI with nothing in it. Is KADHI A DAL?

I AM EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED with the food that has been sent.

The INFORMATION OF THE ITEMS IN THE MEAL IS MISLEADING ON THE WEBSITE.

Glad that I signed up for only the 5 days trial. I would NOT RECOMMEND this tiffin service

featured_reviews.name: AMAR BHARDE
featured_reviews.review_text: Whatever food charges displayed here are totally misleading. In each meal they add Rs. 40 as a delivery charge, though you agreed to pick it from them and not opting for delivery. That means Rs. 40 is hidden charges that they levy on each order.

featured_reviews.name: Renu Dodeja
featured_reviews.review_text: I received tiffin two days properly and on third day I received only sabzi and chapati was missing. I complained but no response received. I then stopped placing order but then too no action was taken. Pathetic service.

featured_reviews.name: anjali joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

featured_reviews.name: Vidit Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking healthbag meal Tiffin services for more than 17 months and still their services as well as food quality remained top notch. Especially the owner Mr. Harish Sharma is such a generous person as he listens the customer request, complaints and he make sure that it will not be done in the near future. I would really recommend to opt for this tiffin services as in South Bombay you can’t get such a delicious homely cooked food at a quite decent price.

featured_reviews.name: Arya Shukla
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good homely food. The taste is very good, and it's comforting, will remind you of your mom's food. Great for people living away from home, very simple and clean, not spicy or oily at all. Also, the rate is very reasonable as compared to other tiffin services, and the customer service is really good. 10/10 recommended.

Medi Claim Policy
Dabbawalas have to work hard to ensure that the right tiffin box reach the right customer at right time. This job involves working in all weather conditions like high rain, cold and extreme summer. Due to this, the chance of falling sick increases tremendously. In case of high medical and hospitalization bill, the financial condition of Dabbawala is severely affected.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers Rs. 100,000 (1 Lakhs) medi claim policy to Dabbawalas covering their entire family. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of falling sick or hospitalization, the Dabbawalas are financially secured.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Insurance
The job of collecting and delivering Tiffin Boxes is a highly risky endeavor undertaken by Dabbawala. Every year thousands of people die on the tracks of Mumbai local trains. In the unfortunate incident of accident of Dabbawala, their families have to undergo an extreme financial hardship which devastates them financially.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers RS. 10,00,000 (10 Lakhs) insurance policy to Dabbawalas. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of an accident, the families of Dabbawalas are financially secured.

Paneer Butter masala combo - just the right flavors
Lassi - Excellent

PS. A review was requested by the staff and they provided complimentary desert. I was gonna give them a 5star review anyway because it was such a good experience. I would recommend patrons to check out dine in offers on popular apps like district and Swiggy dineout for discounts on the total bill.

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place by the Bawa Hotels Group is a good option if you’re in the mood for Punjabi food, just don’t walk in expecting completely authentic flavours. The taste is slightly toned down, but if you set your expectations right, you’ll actually enjoy the food.

The menu is quite well done, and the meal box options are a big plus. Makes ordering super easy without having to overthink or pick too many individual items.

Their parathas are definitely worth trying—served nicely with curd. Do ask for white butter separately though, as it’s not given by default and really makes a difference. The lassi is a must-have here, easily one of the better things on the menu.

Also, a special mention for the Kalimiri chicken shorba. It’s not on the menu, but if they have it, don’t miss it—it’s genuinely very good.

Ambience is nice and comfortable, so no complaints there. Service, however, is quite slow and needs serious improvement, which can get a bit frustrating.

Parking is another issue—since it’s close to the railway station, the area is always crowded and finding a spot is tough. Better to plan that in advance.

Overall, a good place to chill and enjoy a meal, as long as you’re okay overlooking the service and parking hassles.

featured_reviews.name: Suhani Mendonsa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Khar just got a delicious new reason to celebrate with Bawa Kitchen opening its doors this Lohri! From the first bite, it felt like a true Punjabi feast — rich, soulful and full of festive warmth. My absolute favourites were their creamy butter chicken, soft and flavourful chhole kulcha, and the super refreshing lassi that perfectly balanced the spices. Every dish tasted like it was made with love and tradition. If you’re craving authentic Punjabi flavours with a celebratory twist, this is the place to be — go check it out and treat yourself to a hearty, happy meal!
And yes, my festive Lohri fit was specially curated — can’t wait to share it with you all soon!

featured_reviews.name: Susheel Dharmani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Bawa Kitchen and had a good dining experience overall. The place has a simple yet comfortable ambience, perfect for a relaxed meal.
The food quality was nice, especially the North Indian dishes which were flavorful and well-prepared. Portion sizes were decent and prices felt reasonable for the location.
Service was quick and the staff was polite and attentive. It’s a convenient option if you’re staying nearby or looking for a reliable place to eat in Dadar.
Overall, a good spot for a casual meal with consistent quality.

featured_reviews.name: Jawahar Hingorani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I only gave 4 for atmosphere because there was no 4.5 or 4.75…and I got bitten by mosquitoes! The food was on point - I ordered Ajwaini Rawas for my appetizer and it came with this spicy tandoori salad (think Thai Som Yum but not as sweet or wet) and Green chutney which was the perfect accompaniment. For my mains I got the Mutton Beliram (don’t why it’s called that) which was nice and spicy, along with a roomali roti. I’d recommend ordering a naan instead - lots of very moorish sauce to lap up! Got some Jal Jeera with soda to wash it down (not sure about the boondi). Finished off with some Gulabjamun - there is definitely a hint of “Gulab” there! And just look at those soft, pillowy, inviting mounds. 😆

Overall Bawa Kitchen echoes the punjabi ethos when it comes to food. It’s definitely a place I’d recommend and visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Vijita Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text: The Bawa Kitchen delivered a great dining experience—pure Punjabi vibes, full balle-balle. The ambience is lively and authentic, with vibrant cut-outs and the iconic “Khatiya” as a standout photo spot. Veg and non-veg starters are well curated and set the right tone for the meal. Special mention to Rahul for being an excellent host—his food suggestions and positive approach added real value to the experience. Overall, a visit that is absolutely worth it for good food, warm hospitality, and Punjabi flair.

featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

featured_reviews.name: Rachel IndiaTeAyuda
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommended for everyone, even FOREIGNERS like me who dont eat chilly/masalas. Best Homecooked food/Tiffin services in Mumbai!!! We requested special dishes for our kid, gujarati vegetarian meals&dinner and even though we were not in Dadar at first, her delivery service was very fast and delivered the food at the door of our hotel in Marine drive & the other days wherever we were in the sightseeing tours!!! Easy communication and the food is so good that we went specially to meet her in Dadar where we enjoyed in her home, not only her food but her company and lovely family. Clean place & Anjali is like a mother outside your home!!! I cant thank you enough for everything and your hospitality.  You cant leave Mumbai without ordering from Lokhande Tiffin! We will definely come back as soon as we have holidays again!🙏🏽

featured_reviews.name: anish kadu
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried Lokhande Tiffin Service, and I must say, it's one of the best food experiences I've had! The food is absolutely delicious, and the level of cleanliness is impeccable. Anjali Tai, the woman behind it all, is such an amazing person. Not only does she prepare home-cooked, flavorful meals, but she also takes orders for birthday parties and small gatherings. If you're looking for tasty, fresh, and homemade food, I highly recommend visiting her service. The quality is unmatched, and you can really taste the care that goes into every dish! 😇🥰

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Rastogi
featured_reviews.review_text: Really good food, batata bhaji she makes is so tasty and non-veg is very yummy. I had booked tiffin service for my lunch in office, almost everyone loved the food in tiffin. When I had to give a arty for my birthday in office, I ordered chicken biryani, paneer veg mix and chicken curry, everyone appreciated food. She alos made few non-veg starters and we gorged on everything delightfully. It was priced reasonably and lot better than hotel food. Quantity she serves is huge portion in tiffin, enough for two people if your appetite is light. She takes party orders too.
